paragraphs.notes: Markush enumeration table, recorded as one paragraph per the pass instructions. The cells are compound numbers and substituent symbols, not German prose, so zh and en are the same string. The only German on the page is in the header cells 'Nr.' and 'Physikalische Daten' ('No.' and 'Physical data'), left as printed in both fields so the transcription stays a faithful copy of the row grid. The page carries no Tabelle caption and no scaffold drawing; both are on an earlier page. The grey-shaded header row is reprinted at the top of this page. Column headers are printed with a superscript: R with superscript 1; Nr., L and Physikalische Daten carry no superscript. Every digit in CH2CH2, CH2, OCH2CF2CF2H, OCH2CF2CF3, OCH2CF2CF2CF3, OCH2CH2Br, OCH2CH2F, O(CH2)2O(CH2)2OMe and the rest is printed as a subscript and is rendered inline here. The Physikalische Daten cell is EMPTY for all twenty-two rows; the trailing ' | ' on each row is kept so the four-column grid is recoverable. A small ink blot sits roughly in the middle of the Physikalische Daten cell of row 402; it is a scan artifact, not a character. The L column is not constant down the page and is recorded exactly as printed: rows 401 to 403 CH2CH2, rows 404 to 408 CHMe, rows 409 to 417 CH2, rows 418 to 422 CH2CH2. Rows 412, 413, 421 and 422 carry a drawn ring in the R1 cell instead of text; each is recorded in drawings and the cell is marked with a pointer to it. 'O-c-Bu', 'O-c-Pentyl' and 'O-c-Hexyl' are printed with hyphens exactly as shown, the lower-case c denoting cyclo; 'O-i-Pr' likewise. No abbreviation key is printed on this page, so these are transcribed as printed and not expanded. The table body ends after row 422 with a ruled bottom border and the lower fifth of the page is blank; whether the table continues on the following page is not stated on this page.

drawings.notes: Belongs to row Nr. 412; it is that row's R1 value, drawn instead of written. The ring oxygen is drawn at the bottom vertex, one bond from the carbon that carries the exocyclic CH2, so the attachment is at ring position 2 as drawn and not inferred.
